_meta.note: 一个任务一个文件。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Wrath of the Mummy#000.src: Do I know anything about Mummies? Of course! I've spent my entire life studying them!
Wrath of the Mummy#000.dst: 问我懂不懂木乃伊？当然懂！我这辈子都在研究它们！

Wrath of the Mummy#001.src: Mummies aren't known to be weak, especially that one. It's demonic... pure evil. It's easily one of the most powerful specimens I've encountered.
Wrath of the Mummy#001.dst: 木乃伊可没有弱的，尤其是那一具。它是恶魔般的……纯粹的邪恶。绝对是我见过最强大的个体之一。

Wrath of the Mummy#002.src: Unless... look. I've been waiting to get my hands on some pink wool, and the only shop that sells it has just restocked.
Wrath of the Mummy#002.dst: 除非……听着。我一直想弄到一些粉色羊毛，而唯一卖这东西的店刚补了货。

Wrath of the Mummy#003.src: Or better yet, if you happen to have some of that pink wool on you. If you give it to me, well... the tomb is all yours.
Wrath of the Mummy#003.dst: 或者更好的是，你身上刚好带着些粉色羊毛。你要是把它给我，嗯……那座墓就归你了。

Wrath of the Mummy#004.src: Either way, you can take my wagon over there to {p}, but you'll have to make your own way back. Give me [{~} Pink Wool] and I'll let you through.
Wrath of the Mummy#004.dst: 不管怎样，你都可以坐我的马车去 {p}，不过回来得自己想办法。给我 [{~} 粉色羊毛]，我就放你过去。

Wrath of the Mummy#005.src: Have you got me [{~} Pink Wool] yet!? You can get it from the shop in {p}.
Wrath of the Mummy#005.dst: [{~} 粉色羊毛] 弄到了没！？{p} 的商店就有卖。

Wrath of the Mummy#006.src: I don't know you, and you don't know me. Got it?
Wrath of the Mummy#006.dst: 我不认识你，你也不认识我。懂了吗？

Wrath of the Mummy#007.src: Talk to Ormrod in the desert of {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Wrath of the Mummy#007.dst: 与 {p} 沙漠中 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Ormrod 对话。

Wrath of the Mummy#009.src: I live in this camp by choice. A curse follows me... and now trouble starts wherever I go. I left civilization and made camp in the desert, where I could do no more harm.
Wrath of the Mummy#009.dst: 我是自愿住在这个营地的。有个诅咒跟着我……现在我走到哪里，哪里就出事。我离开文明社会，在沙漠里扎营，这样就不会再害到别人。
Wrath of the Mummy#009.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#010.src: I do miss the comforts of {p} some days, though... you look like a learned adventurer. If I asked you to investigate this curse, perhaps you could help me rid myself of it?
Wrath of the Mummy#010.dst: 不过有时候我确实怀念 {p} 的舒适生活……你看起来是个见多识广的冒险者。如果我请你调查这个诅咒，也许你能帮我摆脱它？
Wrath of the Mummy#010.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#011.src: It all started when I discovered an old tomb in the North of the desert. Upon entering it, the ground started shaking and I heard inhuman screams coming from deeper within.
Wrath of the Mummy#011.dst: 一切都要从我在沙漠北边发现一座古墓说起。我一进去，地面就开始震动，我还听到里面深处传来不像人类的尖叫。
Wrath of the Mummy#011.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#012.src: I ran as fast as I could, learning later the tomb housed the remains of an ancient Mummy... which I accidentally awoke. If the Mummy could be put back to rest, perhaps the curse would go away.
Wrath of the Mummy#012.dst: 我拼命地跑，后来才知道那座墓里葬着一具古老的木乃伊……而我不小心把它弄醒了。如果能让木乃伊重新安息，也许诅咒就会消失。
Wrath of the Mummy#012.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#013.src: I have heard of a scholar in {p}, Achper, who may know more about the tomb. I am reluctant to return to the city, in case my presence hurts anyone else.
Wrath of the Mummy#013.dst: 我听说 {p} 有位学者叫 Achper，他可能更了解那座墓。我不太想回城里，怕我的存在又伤到别人。
Wrath of the Mummy#013.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#014.src: If you would truly like to help, you should start by talking to him.
Wrath of the Mummy#014.dst: 如果你真的想帮忙，就先去找他谈谈吧。
Wrath of the Mummy#014.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#015.src: Talk to Achper in {p} about the curse at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Wrath of the Mummy#015.dst: 与 {p} [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Achper 谈谈诅咒的事。

Wrath of the Mummy#016.src: If I know about mummies? Of course! I've spent my entire life studying them!
Wrath of the Mummy#016.dst: 问我懂不懂木乃伊？当然懂！我这辈子都在研究它们！
Wrath of the Mummy#016.speaker: Achper

Wrath of the Mummy#017.src: They usually are very hard to reach, hidden in their tomb... and they don't like being disturbed.
Wrath of the Mummy#017.dst: 它们通常很难接近，藏在墓穴里……而且它们不喜欢被打扰。
Wrath of the Mummy#017.speaker: Achper

Wrath of the Mummy#018.src: I have heard of the curse that follows Ormrod, and the only way to remove its effects would be to kill the mummy.
Wrath of the Mummy#018.dst: 我听说过跟着 Ormrod 的那个诅咒，唯一能消除它的办法就是杀掉那具木乃伊。
Wrath of the Mummy#018.speaker: Achper

Wrath of the Mummy#019.src: The tomb lies in the North of the desert, but be very careful!
Wrath of the Mummy#019.dst: 墓穴在沙漠北边，不过千万要小心！
Wrath of the Mummy#019.speaker: Achper

Wrath of the Mummy#020.src: Mummies aren't known to be weak... especially that one. It's demonic... pure evil, It's easily one of the most powerful specimens I've encountered.
Wrath of the Mummy#020.dst: 木乃伊可没有弱的……尤其是那一具。它是恶魔般的……纯粹的邪恶，绝对是我见过最强大的个体之一。
Wrath of the Mummy#020.speaker: Achper

Wrath of the Mummy#021.src: On top of that, the Creden Tibus bandit clan have been ransacking the tombs around the desert. You might run into trouble with them, so be prepared.
Wrath of the Mummy#021.dst: 除此之外，Creden Tibus 强盗团一直在洗劫沙漠一带的墓穴。你可能会碰上他们的麻烦，做好准备。
Wrath of the Mummy#021.speaker: Achper

Wrath of the Mummy#022.src: Attempt to enter the Mummy's tomb at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Wrath of the Mummy#022.dst: 设法进入 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的木乃伊之墓

Wrath of the Mummy#023.src: Stop! If you're thinking about looting the tomb, you're too late. The Creden Tibus have laid claim here, and you're not getting past.
Wrath of the Mummy#023.dst: 站住！如果你想来盗墓，那你来晚了。Creden Tibus 已经占了这里，你别想过去。
Wrath of the Mummy#023.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#024.src: Mummy? Curse? I don't know anything about that, but I can't let you in - how do I know you won't just grab the gold?
Wrath of the Mummy#024.dst: 木乃伊？诅咒？我不知道那些事，但我不能让你进去——我怎么知道你不会顺手拿走金子？
Wrath of the Mummy#024.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#025.src: Unless... look. I've been waiting to get my hands on some pink wool, and the only shop that sells it has just been restocked.
Wrath of the Mummy#025.dst: 除非……听着。我一直想弄到一些粉色羊毛，而唯一卖这东西的店刚补了货。
Wrath of the Mummy#025.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#026.src: Trouble is, the shop's over in {p} and I'm stuck guarding this tomb. If you go and grab me some before it sells out, I can look the other way.
Wrath of the Mummy#026.dst: 问题是，那家店在 {p}，而我得守着这座墓走不开。如果你趁卖光之前去帮我买点来，我就当没看见。
Wrath of the Mummy#026.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#027.src: You can take my wagon over there, but you'll have to make your own way back. Give me [{~} Pink Wool] and I'll let you through.
Wrath of the Mummy#027.dst: 你可以坐我的马车过去，不过回来得自己想办法。给我 [{~} 粉色羊毛]，我就放你过去。
Wrath of the Mummy#027.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#028.src: Use the bandit's wagon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to get to {p}.

Wrath of the Mummy#029.src: Bring back [{~} Pink Wool] to the bandit at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Wrath of the Mummy#030.src: Well, whaddya know? You got some Pink Wool! Okay, hand it here and I'll look the other way and let you into the tomb.
Wrath of the Mummy#030.dst: 哟，没想到啊？你真弄到粉色羊毛了！好，交给我，我就当没看见，放你进墓里。
Wrath of the Mummy#030.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#031.src: Just don't touch any of the gold, hmm? And if I were you, I wouldn't go in too deep.
Wrath of the Mummy#031.dst: 只是别碰任何金子，嗯？要是我是你，就不会往里面走太深。
Wrath of the Mummy#031.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#032.src: The clan was going to explore further inside, but the sounds...
Wrath of the Mummy#032.dst: 强盗团本来打算再往里面探索，可是那些声音……
Wrath of the Mummy#032.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#033.src: Anyway, I'll still let you inside if you want. Just remember, if anyone asks, this conversation never happened.
Wrath of the Mummy#033.dst: 总之，你想进去的话我还是会放你进去。只是记住，要是有人问起，我们从没说过这些话。
Wrath of the Mummy#033.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#034.src: Enter the tomb at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and kill the Mummy.

Wrath of the Mummy#035.src: Bring [{~} Mummy's Bandage] to Ormrod at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Wrath of the Mummy#035.dst: 把 [{~} 木乃伊的绷带] 带给 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Ormrod。

Wrath of the Mummy#036.src: Hello, again... have you had any luck?
Wrath of the Mummy#036.dst: 你好，又见面了……有进展吗？
Wrath of the Mummy#036.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#037.src: Those are the Mummy's bandages?! You did it? My curse is finally lifted!
Wrath of the Mummy#037.dst: 那是木乃伊的绷带？！你办到了？我的诅咒终于解除了！
Wrath of the Mummy#037.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#038.src: I can't thank you enough! As a reward, take this rag I got from the Mummy when I entered the tomb.
Wrath of the Mummy#038.dst: 真是太感谢你了！作为奖励，拿着这块破布吧，是我进墓时从木乃伊身上扯下来的。
Wrath of the Mummy#038.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#039.src: I am not strong enough to wear it, but I'm sure you are! Take these emeralds too, that's the least I can do!
Wrath of the Mummy#039.dst: 我没强到能穿上它，但我相信你可以！这些绿宝石也拿去吧，这是我最起码能做的！
Wrath of the Mummy#039.speaker: Ormrod
